0022600028.text: The Dallas Mavericks (4-4, 2-2 at home, currently on a two-game losing streak) host the 1-7 Utah Jazz, who have lost six straight, in the Mavericks' 9th game of the season and an Emirates NBA Cup West Group A matchup. Dallas sits 11th in the West and 5th in the Southwest, 2.5 games back, while Utah is 14th in the West. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, with no games played yet in 2026-27, and Dallas won their last meeting in Dallas 138-120. Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II, Sergio de Larrea and Tarik Biberovic, and Max Christie is listed as day-to-day with a hip injury, while Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr., Jusuf Nurkic and Trey Alexander.
